**Howard C. Adelman, M.D.** is a nationally recognized forensic pathologist and medical consultant known for his work in [field/specific area].
## Early life and education
Gettsburg College & University of Basel Faculty of Medicine (in German, Medizinische Fakultät der Universität Basel). It’s one of the oldest medical schools in Switzerland and part of the University of Basel.
Howard C. Adelman, M.D. was a nationally recognized medical consultant and forensic pathologist with decades of experience in medico-legal consulting, forensic pathology, and laboratory leadership. He is most known for being the medical examiner of the famous Amityville Horror murder upon which books and movies were made.
